move.title: Hosting
move.hint: A host refused is said « refused » in the list, with its reason and the code of the rule; it is not sent.
move.already: It is its host already: nothing is added.
move.cycle: refused: it hosts it, or is it
move.incompatible: refused: not a host it admits
move.pending: Move to {host} waiting for the server; the host shown stays until it answers.
move.valid: Move to {host} in the draft, held by its simulation; the host changes once the draft is applied.
move.refused: Move to {host} refused by the server
move.kept: The operation stays in the draft; another host chosen replaces it.
move.failed: Move to {host} not added to the draft
